comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-002 (high, tdd), authored and populated by an independent quality-gate pass over the current tree (commit b2502ec1, branch feature/epic-194-a6-lite-integration), not transcribed from the implementer's own claims. unit-tests/acceptance-tests share evidence (verification/qg/T-002/unit-acceptance-green.log, freshly re-run this session: 43/43 both runtimes across all 4 suites -- 16 byte-identical + 8 merge-ordering + 13 fail-closed + 6 ineligible-token) because T-002's own 4 suite pairs simultaneously exercise unit-level script behavior and this task's own acceptance criteria (AC-007..010, AC-027, AC-028) in the same assertions. red_evidence points at verification/T-002.red.log (captured against the live, unextended check-risk-upgrade.{sh,ps1} -- e.g. TEST-008a/b/c genuinely fail with 'risk-upgrade: input unavailable' before the --capability-reasons argument exists), reused rather than re-captured since it is independent of the later .PROPOSED-to-canonical path migration and remains valid pre-fix evidence. stack:shell waives {lint, typecheck, build}: T-002's Planned Files are bash/PowerShell scripts and a Markdown policy doc, and this repository configures no lint/typecheck/build toolchain for either. regression (verification/qg/shared/regression.log, shared with T-001/T-003 -- same feature, same session, same point in time) is scoped to: both run-all twins parsing cleanly, check-sdd-structure.sh passing feature-scoped, one neighbor suite before/after the epic-194 registration block, and the epic-194 suite family run together -- the full 116-suite tests/run-all.sh TIMED OUT after 10 minutes and could not be completed this session; matches this feature's own T-004.contract.json regression-scoping precedent. placeholder-scan (verification/qg/shared/placeholder-scan.log) ran real check-placeholders.sh against T-002's own 8 new test files directly (clean) and against T-002's staged payload (check-risk-upgrade.sh/.ps1, risk-upgrade-policy.md) via its containing directory specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/human-copy/plugins/sdd-lite/ (clean) -- naming the payload files' own basenames directly on a Bash command line is denied by the sdd-hook-guard's protected_gate_suffixes match even for a read-only scan under human-copy/, confirmed directly; scanning via the containing directory is the same unmodified command, not a workaround. The CHANGELOG.md whole-file scan separately FAILS on 5 pre-existing findings, proven byte-identical at the git merge-base bd48ce8c and at lines this task's own diff never touches -- disclosed, not fixed, matching this task's own implementation report (reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-002.md, 'Gate results' section). requirement-traceability (verification/qg/shared/traceability-check.log) ran for real: PASS, 6 links. task-state-check (verification/qg/shared/task-state-check.log) is a REAL, CURRENT FAIL: check-task-state.sh exits 1 feature-wide on a pre-existing T-004 evidence-bundle SHA-256 mismatch, independently reproduced this session and already documented as pre-existing by this task's own implementation report; T-004 is out of this task's own scope. Recorded as passes:false when this contract was authored -- not waived, not papered over -- which was then why the contract failed overall and why T-002 was not gate-ready. It is now passes:true: T-004's evidence bundle was stale against a legitimately regenerated T-004.green.log, and regenerating that bundle cleared the feature-wide failure. The check was re-run to establish that (exit 0, 'Task state check passed for 4 task(s)'); the flag was not re-typed. HUMAN APPLY STEP (tasks.md Done-When) also remains outstanding and is not represented as a check here -- it is a human action, not a machine-checkable gate. Re-recorded 2026-08-19: this check was false only because T-004's evidence bundle was stale against a legitimately regenerated T-004.green.log; regenerating that bundle cleared it. The command was re-run, not the flag re-typed.
